summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of UINSA CPL app. 15/15 pytest cases passed covering auth, CRUD (fakultas/prodi/matakuliah), grades weighted-average correctness (including 92.22 example and multi-criteria 75.5), dashboard shape, and auth guards (401 on all protected endpoints). Frontend E2E verified: login redirects to dashboard, KPIs correct (2/3/4/0), navigation across all pages works, Input Nilai form saves a grade with correct renormalized weighted score (Pratinjau shows 92.22 A and stored row shows 92.22 A). Delete grade works with confirmation toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Legend shows literal text 'count count count count count' instead of grade labels A/B/C/D/E. Recharts Legend uses the dataKey 'count' as the name. Should set name or use nameKey='grade' and Legend formatter.

action_items: Fix Distribusi Predikat legend to display grade names (A/B/C/D/E) instead of 'count'. In Recharts, pass nameKey='grade' on Pie/Bar or Legend formatter mapping payload.value from grade field.
critical_code_review_comments: CORSMiddleware in server.py hardcodes 'http://localhost:3000' along with FRONTEND_URL env. Works, but consider a list from CORS_ORIGINS env (already declared, unused).
dashboard() total_matkul variable computed but never returned; dead code (line 437). Safe to remove.
Cookies set with samesite='none' + secure=True require HTTPS (fine for prod). Local HTTP dev browsers may drop them; testing here uses https preview so OK.
seed_admin correctly rehashes password when env password changes (good).
No brute-force lockout implemented (playbook mentions after 5 fails). Not required by spec but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows working; 1 minor legend label issue)

seed_data_creation: None; used existing seed (2 fakultas, 3 prodi, 4 matakuliah). Test-created records were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Score inputs use lowercase suffix data-testid: cpl-score-input-cpl-s1 etc. Selects are shadcn Radix (BUTTON with role combobox); use click + get_by_role('option', name=...). Weighted-average example S1=80,KU1=90,KK1=100 => 92.22 A verified end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Distribusi Predikat legend: In Dashboard.js, the Pie/Bar Legend uses the numeric dataKey 'count' as the display name because 'name' prop was not set. Suggested fix: pass nameKey='grade' to Pie or add Legend formatter={(value, entry) => entry.payload.grade}.
